newsitem.title: SWEDEN: RESEARCH ALERT-Goldman has buy on Autoliv.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Goldman has buy on Autoliv.

text.p: Goldman Sachs said on Tuesday it had a 'buy' recommendation on Swedish/U.S. car safety equipment company Autoliv and a target price of $43 in three to six months.
At 1410 GMT Autoliv's shares were trading 20 crowns higher at 307.5 crowns.
The share was the second most actively traded on the Stockholm Stock Exchange on Tuesday with shares worth 614 million crowns changing hands.
The target price of $43 corresponds to about 346 crowns.
"We upgraded Autoliv last night and the share is now on our recommended list in the U.S. and Europe," a Goldman Sachs source told Reuters.
This is the first analysis Goldman Sachs has done of Autoliv Inc since the merger of Swedish Autoliv with the car safety equipment unit of U.S. group Morton International Inc in May this yeear.
The valuation of Autoliv's share is not high in relation to the growth expected in sales and earnings, the source said.
